tasks.detail: 启动驱动栈 + MoveIt（已在跑就跳过），然后打印四项门。控制器激活由任务 ② 负责。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; if [ -z "$CS625_ROBOT_IP" ]; then echo "[开工] CS625_ROBOT_IP 未设置，写进 ~/.cs625_local.env"; exit 1; fi; if pgrep -f "ros2 launch cs625_bringup" >/dev/null; then echo "[开工] 驱动栈已在运行"; else mkdir -p runtime/logs; nohup ros2 launch cs625_bringup real_base.launch.py launch_driver:=true robot_ip:="$CS625_ROBOT_IP" local_ip:="${CS625_HOST_IP:-192.168.1.100}" description_package:=eli_cs_robot_description description_file:="$PWD/install/cs625_ap_description/share/cs625_ap_description/urdf/cs625_active_perception.urdf.xacro" headless_mode:=true launch_moveit:=true launch_rviz:=false launch_sensor_adapter:=false activate_joint_controller:=false execute:=false require_confirmation:=true >> runtime/logs/driver_$(date +%H%M%S).log 2>&1 & echo "[开工] 已在后台启动驱动栈"; fi; sleep 45; python3 scripts/control_health.py --activate; python3 scripts/preflight_motion.py; echo "[开工] 完成：① 真机就绪后可运行 ②/③"

tasks.label: ⑥ DSH · 启动/打开界面
tasks.detail: 先在系统里找正在运行的 dsh web 实例（不管端口是 3080、8080 还是别的，优先最新的那个）：能找到就用日志里带 token 的 URL 打开，或直接打开 http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/（浏览器 cookie 30 天内有效）。有 dsh 正在启动（例如 npx 正在装包）时只等待，不启动第二个——重复启动才是端口被占用的来源。都没有才后台启动 dsh web。等价于手动执行：cd <workspace> && npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web。
tasks.command:
bash -lc 'cd "${workspaceFolder}" || exit 1
mkdir -p runtime/logs
log="runtime/logs/dsh_web.log"
port="${CS625_DSH_PORT:-3080}"

listening() { (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$1") 2>/dev/null; }

open_url() {
  local url="$1"
  if grep -qi microsoft /proc/version 2>/dev/null && command -v cmd.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ( cd /mnt/c && cmd.exe /c start "" "$url" ) >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
  fi
  if command -v xdg-open >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    xdg-open "$url" >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
  fi
  echo "  (浏览器没有自动打开，请手动复制上面的 URL)"
  return 1
}

token_url() {
  grep -oE "http://127\.0\.0\.1:$1/\?token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+" "$log" 2>/dev/null | tail -1
}

url_ok() {
  local code
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 4 "$1" 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] || [ "$code" = "302" ] || [ "$code" = "303" ] || [ "$code" = "304" ]
}

dsh_cmd() {
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web"; return 0; fi
  if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web"; return 0; fi
  if command -v dsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "dsh web"; return 0; fi
  _np=$(ls -dt "$HOME"/.npm/_npx/*/node_modules/.bin/dsh 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$_np" ] && [ -x "$_np" ]; then echo "$_np web"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

dsh_pids() {
  local p cmd
  for p in $(pgrep -f "dsh web" 2>/dev/null); do
    if [ ! -r "/proc/$p/cmdline" ]; then continue; fi
    cmd=$(tr "\0" " " < "/proc/$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null)
    case "$cmd" in
      *bash*|*pgrep*|*grep*) continue ;;
    esac
    case "$cmd" in
      *dsh*web*) echo "$p" ;;
    esac
  done
}

dsh_ports() {
  local p et lp
  for p in $(dsh_pids); do
    et=$(ps -o etimes= -p "$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
    for lp in $(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -F "pid=$p," | grep -oE "127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+" | cut -d: -f2); do
      printf "%s %s\n" "${et:-999999}" "$lp"
    done
  done | sort -n -k1,1 | cut -d" " -f2
}

open_running() {
  local lp u
  for lp in "$@"; do
    u=$(token_url "$lp")
    if [ -n "$u" ] && url_ok "$u"; then
      echo "[dsh] 复用本任务启动的实例 127.0.0.1:$lp"
      echo "[dsh] $u"
      open_url "$u"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "[dsh] 127.0.0.1:$lp 上已有 DSH Web（不是本任务启动的，token 只在它自己的终端里）"
    echo "[dsh] 打开 http://127.0.0.1:$lp/ —— 浏览器里已有登录 cookie 就能进"
    echo "      若页面提示 401：到启动它的终端复制带 token 的 URL，或先关掉它（在它自己的终端按 Ctrl+C）再重跑本任务"
    open_url "http://127.0.0.1:$lp/"
    return 0
  done
  return 1
}

ports=$(dsh_ports)
if [ -n "$ports" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 已在运行：$(echo $ports | tr " " ",")"
  open_running $ports && exit 0
fi

if [ -n "$(dsh_pids)" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 检测到 DSH 正在启动（第一次可能是 npx 装包，要几分钟）"
  echo "[dsh] 这次不再启动第二个进程（那才会报端口被占用），等它就绪，最多 10 分钟"
  n=0
  for i in $(seq 1 1200); do
    ports=$(dsh_ports)
    [ -n "$ports" ] && break
    n=$((n + 1))
    if [ $((n % 60)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "[dsh] 等待中，已 $((n / 2)) 秒"; fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  if [ -n "$ports" ]; then
    open_running $ports && exit 0
  fi
  echo "[dsh] 10 分钟都没有端口在监听，改为自己启动"
fi

cmd=$(dsh_cmd) || { echo "[dsh] 找不到 npx / node / dsh：先在自己的终端里跑 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 确认可用"; exit 1; }
: > "$log"
echo "[dsh] 没在运行 → 后台启动：$cmd --port $port（日志 $log）"
setsid nohup $cmd --no-open --port "$port" >>"$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
n=0
ports=""
for i in $(seq 1 1200); do
  ports=$(dsh_ports)
  [ -n "$ports" ] && break
  if grep -q "EADDRINUSE" "$log" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[dsh] 启动失败：端口已被别的进程占用。日志末尾："
    tail -12 "$log"
    echo "[dsh] 如果刚才已经有一个实例在跑，直接重跑本任务就会复用它"
    exit 1
  fi
  n=$((n + 1))
  if [ $((n % 60)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "[dsh] 启动中，已 $((n / 2)) 秒（首次装包可能要几分钟）"; fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ -z "$ports" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 10 分钟没起来，日志末尾："
  tail -20 "$log"
  exit 1
fi
open_running $ports && exit 0
exit 1
'
